realtime_memories.content: Issue #15 implemented via PR #16: OAuth/subscription auth support for Claude backend. Users can run `code-evolve init --agent claude --auth-mode oauth` to use `claude login` instead of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. CI always uses api-key mode. CodeRabbit review applied: use process.argv.includes() for Commander default detection, use `claude auth status` for OAuth validation.
Config flow pattern: EvolveConfig (config.json) -> readConfig() -> writeEnvFile() for cron -> spawn env for direct runs -> shell adapter. New config fields must flow through all layers.
code-evolve is a standalone npm CLI package separate from auto-modeler-evolve. Monorepo detection changes in auto-modeler-evolve don't require changes in code-evolve.
Fixed claude-never-forgets stop hook infinite loop: added temp-file lock so cleanup block only fires once per session. Updated both cache and marketplace copies of stop_cleanup.py.
User prefers not to re-run CodeRabbit if it already reviewed in PR comments. Trust the existing review rather than re-running.
Merged and branch deleted. Issue #15 is closed.
Update README to match the current version of the application.
